verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents a built-in Jira UI for viewing and managing Jira issues inside Bitbucket, plus the ability to open Jira tickets directly from the PR screen. That covers both halves of the story, and commits containing issue keys also auto-update Jira issue status. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond product-page marketing claims, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Jira UI, and evidence of support for external trackers other than Jira.
